name: youtube-mcp
description: YouTube (social): me, read_comments, reply_comment, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a doc

platform_mcp_youtube_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_youtube_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

platform_mcp_youtube_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_youtube_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

platform_mcp_youtube_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_youtube_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl. 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: channels.list?mine=true: account.items[0] is the authenticated user's channel (snippet, statistics).

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: `post_id` is the video ID; returns top-level comments (1 quota unit). Pagination is by pageToken, so `page` is ignored. `id` is the top-level comment id to pass to reply_comment.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: comments.insert 'Creates a reply to an existing comment' (50 quota units); `comment_id` is the top-level comment id.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: videos.delete 'Deletes a YouTube video' (`post_id` = video ID, 50 quota units); answers 204.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: videos.list?part=statistics: metrics carries viewCount, likeCount, favoriteCount, commentCount (strings). An unknown video id is `invalid_input`.
